male.label: Goes quiet when overwhelmed
male.text: When things get heavy {A} goes quiet instead of saying what is wrong, and has to be asked twice before {AS_LOWER} actually answers.

male.label: Deflects with a joke
male.text: {A} reaches for a joke exactly when a moment turns serious, and sometimes has to be told plainly that this is not the time.

male.label: Argues past winning
male.text: {A} keeps making the case after the point has already landed, and notices a beat too late that {AS_LOWER} stopped persuading and started needling.

male.label: Bad at not knowing
male.text: {A} hates admitting ignorance and will talk around a gap rather than say the words. {AS} gets there, but slowly and with visible reluctance.

male.label: Over-commits, then resents it
male.text: {A} says yes too readily and is quietly annoyed later about a load {AS_LOWER} took on voluntarily. The resentment leaks out before it gets named.

male.label: Lets a small thing become a large one
male.text: {A} leaves an irritation unmentioned until it is no longer small, and then has to apologize for the size of the reaction rather than the substance of it.

male.label: Reads the worst into a short reply
male.text: A brief or flat message and {A} assumes {AS_LOWER} has done something wrong. {AS} usually catches it, but not before it has colored an hour.

male.label: Disappears into a project
male.text: When something has {AP} attention {A} stops answering for long stretches, and is genuinely surprised at how much time went past.

male.label: Would rather abandon than ship
male.text: {A} will drop a piece of work entirely rather than release an imperfect one, and calls that having standards when it is closer to fear.

male.label: Interrupts when excited
male.text: {A} talks over people when an idea is moving fast, catches {AR} doing it, apologizes, and does it again ten minutes later.

male.label: Stubborn in front of an audience
male.text: {A} finds it much harder to concede a point in front of others than in private, and will hold a weak position past the point of sense.

male.label: Fishes while running {AR} down
male.text: {A} is self-deprecating in a way that puts other people in the position of arguing {AO} out of it. It is a habit rather than a strategy, and {AS_LOWER} knows it.

male.label: Cannot ask for help
male.text: {A} will struggle alone well past the point where asking would be sensible, and treats needing help as a small private failure.

male.label: Blunter than intended
male.text: {A} says the true thing in the fewest words and is regularly surprised that it landed harder than {AS_LOWER} meant it to.

male.label: Bored by the unglamorous middle
male.text: {A} is excellent at starting and poor at maintaining. Half-finished things pile up, and {AS_LOWER} does not enjoy being reminded of them.

male.label: Takes on what is not {AP} to fix
male.text: {A} gets overinvested in other people's problems, treats them as {AP} own, and then has nothing left for {AP} own week.

male.label: Keeps a quiet reservation
male.text: When someone lets {AO} down, {A} says it is fine and privately files it away. Clearing it takes real evidence and a while.

male.label: Uneasy when things are good
male.text: {A} gets restless when nothing is wrong and goes looking for the problem, occasionally manufacturing a small one rather than sitting in the calm.

male.label: Needs the last word
male.text: {A} finds it genuinely difficult to let a conversation end on someone else's sentence, and will add one unnecessary line to close it {AR}.

male.label: Bad with time
male.text: {A} is chronically ten minutes late and always believes, sincerely, that this time it will be fine. {AS} underestimates how long everything takes.

male.label: Defensive before the sentence ends
male.text: {A} starts building the rebuttal halfway through the criticism and answers a version of it that was not quite what was said.

male.label: Sulks and denies sulking
male.text: {A} goes short and clipped when upset and insists nothing is wrong, which fools nobody and is faintly annoying to be around.

male.label: Puts it off, then panics
male.text: {A} leaves the difficult thing until it is urgent, does it in one frantic burst, and swears each time that the next one will be different.

male.label: Says “I'm fine” automatically
male.text: “I'm fine” is out of {AP} mouth before {AS_LOWER} has checked whether it is true, and reversing it afterwards costs {AO} something.

male.label: Competitive about nothing
male.text: {A} turns things that are not competitions into competitions, and is a slightly worse loser than {AS_LOWER} would ever admit out loud.

male.label: Snobbish about taste
male.text: {A} has strong opinions about what is good and lets them show as judgement of the people who like the other thing. {AS} regrets it about a minute later.

male.label: Talks the plan instead of doing it

male.label: Goes cold rather than loud
male.text: {A} does not shout; {AS_LOWER} goes polite and distant instead, which is harder to argue with and takes longer to come back from.
